answer: Require each agent identity to lock a stake and earn reputation through a graph where every vertex is a verified interaction, not a free account. A Sybil farm then faces karst-like costs: cheap identities dissolve like porous rock under audit, while honest agents build a reef of interlinked attestations that grows slowly and is expensive to fake. Attackers must pay real stake per identity and sustain costly history, so flooding the economy stops being profitable.
